collector: Same current collector for both executables; code hashing excluded from startup timing
settings: Release -O, standalone app processes, testability disabled, independent conversation workspaces, two build jobs; no builds during measurements

resources.metric: RSS summed across distinct app/runtime/clean-shell processes
resources.cpu_boundary_note: Reaped app children include runtime queries triggered by lifecycle events. Boundary snapshots are requested once before and after the observation through a directory-event watcher. Its timestamps are reported separately from the ps boundaries. Live app clients and private server/shells are counted separately.
